scenes.headline: Thousands of hours.
scenes.say: Robot fleets record thousands of hours. Real failures are rare, and no one has time to find them.
scenes.sub: 8 GB · 788 rides · 50 hours of public robot video

scenes.headline: Argon finds the failures.
scenes.say: Argon reviews it all, and keeps only the failures that matter.

scenes.headline: Rebuilt from real footage.
scenes.say: It rebuilds each one as a digital twin, from a few real frames.

scenes.headline: Then made harder.
scenes.say: Then it asks: what if someone steps out? What if a truck runs the light?

scenes.headline: Argon writes the reward for RL.
scenes.say: It writes the reward for reinforcement learning, from good rides and bad ones.

scenes.headline: RL trains on 40 variants.
scenes.say: Reinforcement learning retrains the robot on forty variants of the failure.
scenes.sub: Before: hits the pole. After: steers around it.

scenes.headline: Argon catches it cheating.
scenes.say: When it cheats, parking to avoid a crash, or launching off a curb, Argon catches it, and rewrites the reward.

scenes.headline: Now it doesn't fail.
scenes.say: Now, indoors and outdoors, the robots that crashed pass safely. Argon approves.
scenes.sub: Indoors and outdoors. Approved by Argon.

scenes.headline: Safe for every site.
scenes.say: One update fixed one site but broke another. Argon blocked it, until it passed both.

scenes.headline: Federated Robot Learning
scenes.say: Hindsight. Federated robot learning, enabled by Argon.
